name: i9_7a_top_floor_task_schedule_and_admission
note: Stock Top Floor entry for a fresh unranked player: D512 answers the read-only viewer state (mode switch and special tab, rank 0, no offers) while the special write MIDs still refuse with the stock not-open code 40001. The asset set lacks windows/arena/mode/schedule/schedule.csb, so ArenaModeScheduleWindow cannot open on this asset set (I9-7A-SCHEDULE-CSB); the scenario asserts the data the window would read and does not claim its rendering.
steps: lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena') assert(w, 'vc-task-arena-window-missing') assert(w.isShowArenaMode, 'vc-task-viewer-missing') local a=w.arena_ assert(a and a.modeType and a.modeType>0 and a.mRank==0 and #(a.mEnemies or {})==0, 'vc-task-viewer-state')

lua:xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.ARENA_MODE_FIGHT_PRE,{enemy_id=0},function(code,body) assert(code~=xyd.error.OK and body and body.error_code==40001,'vc-task-write-admitted') print('vc-task-write-refused') end)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena') w.arena_:loadModeSchedule(function(infos) assert(#infos==2, 'vc-task-current-next-schedule-missing') for _,slot in ipairs(infos) do assert(slot.mode>=1 and slot.mode<=6, 'vc-task-invalid-mode') assert(slot.end_time>slot.start_time, 'vc-task-invalid-slot') end __vcScheduleRead=true end)
